Oak dieback 2-class classification, ~2700 plots, RF (CRswir+CRre, Nyears=2). Matched pair (rule 1): LOOCV vs SLOOCV with 10 km buffer, raw references, mean all years; digitised visually from Fig. 10 (precision ~0.005). Proposed framework (expanded references) has SLOOCV BA ~0.730 (Fig. 10) vs random 5-fold x10 BA 0.78 (Table IV) -> random_cv_alt / sensitivity. OA drop ~5% stated in text only. Plots from 2020 systematic road sampling plus other campaigns -> clustered (road surveys per rule 9).

Central Africa forest AGB, 28,225 1-km pixels from inventory (logging concessions), RF with MODIS+environmental vars (RFRSE). Primary: random 10-fold vs spatial 44-fold cluster CV (cluster max distance 150 km; AGB autocorrelation range ~120 km). R2 = squared Pearson r; RMSPE reported (Mg/ha). B-LOO series 0-150 km in Fig. 5 (R2 ~0.50 at 0 km, ~0.15 at 50 km, ~0 beyond 100 km) -> sensitivity.

Reed canarygrass presence/absence in floodplain forest understories (UMR), inventory points on 100.6 m grid (2008-2019); ensemble of RF, XGBoost, BART (main mapping model). Primary: random 10-fold vs spatial 10-fold block CV (4254 m blocks from blockCV) with same predictors; Spatial CV + EDF variant (adds spatial predictors) is non-primary (ensemble ~0.717 acc, ~0.782 AUC, ~0.430 TSS). Values digitised visually from Fig. 2 (precision ~0.005). RF alone: acc 0.747/0.673, AUC 0.815/0.724, TSS 0.495/0.350.
